summary: Pasqal Holding SA filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of its business combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II, a SPAC, on August 27, 2026. The merged entity, Pasqal Holding SA, will list on Nasdaq under PSQL (shares) and PSQLW (warrants). Approximately $360 million in cash is available at closing to fund quantum-computing deployment. Shareholder approval occurred August 25, 2026. The deal was structured as a series of mergers under an agreement dated February 28, 2026. Watch for post-merger trading performance and execution of the capital deployment roadmap.
